name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Income support of ₹6,000 per year per eligible landholding farmer family, paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 into an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or at a Common Service Centre. e-KYC is required, and the bank account must be linked with Aadhaar.
helpline: 155261 or 011-24300606 (check the official portal for current numbers)
source_note: PM-KISAN official portal and operational guidelines.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, crop insurance)
benefit: Insurance against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases. Farmer pays at most 2% of the sum insured for kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial and horticultural crops; the government pays the rest.
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank, a Common Service Centre or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date your state notifies for the season. Report crop loss within 72 hours through the PMFBY helpline or your insurer.
source_note: PMFBY operational guidelines (premium caps); enrolment dates are notified by each state.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) with interest subvention
benefit: Short-term farm credit from banks. Under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme, short-term KCC loans up to ₹3 lakh carry a concessional 7% interest rate, and a 3% prompt-repayment incentive brings the effective rate to 4%. Budget 2025-26 announced raising the loan limit under the scheme to ₹5 lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, regional rural bank or cooperative bank with your land records and Aadhaar. Confirm the current limit, rate and collateral rules with the bank.
helpline: Your bank branch or the Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551
source_note: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare reply in Rajya Sabha (18 March 2025); terms are reviewed every year.
